record.one_liner: Apify platform provides a REST API and API clients to control web scraping and browser automation Actors, and supports authentication via Bearer tokens or API keys.

auth_methods.quote: To access the Apify API in your integrations, you need to authenticate using your secret API token.

access_test.quote: Your gateway to the Apify platform is your Apify account. The great thing about creating an account is that we support integration with both Google and GitHub, which takes only about 30 seconds! Create your account on the sign up page.

access_ship.quote: Create your account on the sign up page. Check your email, you should have a verification email with a link. Click it! Done!

api_type.quote: The Apify API (version 2) provides programmatic access to the Apify platform. The API is organized around RESTful HTTP endpoints.

api_breadth.quote: All aspects of the Apify platform can be controlled via a REST API, which is described in detail in the API Reference.

official_mcp.quote: The official Apify Model Context Protocol (MCP) server gives AI agents web scraping, data extraction, and browser automation through thousands of ready-made Actors from Apify Store
